title: Exam Orientation and How to Study

header.html: Exam overview, domain map and answer technique (all domains)
Know the exam format and the five domains with their weights; use a repeatable method to answer every question
the official Microsoft Learn AZ-104 study guide and exam page, skills measured as of October 26, 2023

html:
1The exam at a glance

Item Fact
Passing score 700 or greater on a scale of 1 to 1,000
Time 100 minutes (a request for 30 extra minutes is possible if the exam is not in your preferred language)
Format Proctored; may include interactive components
Content Most questions cover generally available features; preview features can appear if commonly used
Questions The official pages do not state the number
Retake After 24 hours for the first retake
Audience Azure administrators with experience in compute, storage, networking and identity

Old name Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) is now Microsoft Entra ID. The study guide already uses the new name.

Exam tip

. Expect scenario questions ("which option meets the requirement with the least administrative effort") and portal or command choices. Learn what each feature is for and which scope it applies at.

2The five domains

Domain Weight
1. Manage Azure identities and governance 20-25%
2. Implement and manage storage 15-20%
3. Deploy and manage Azure compute resources 20-25%
4. Implement and manage virtual networking 15-20%
5. Monitor and maintain Azure resources 10-15%
Exam tip

. Identities (20-25%) plus compute (20-25%) is up to half the exam. Monitoring is the smallest domain, but it is easy marks if you study it.

3How to answer every question

  1. Read the last line to see what is asked.
  2. Underline the requirement: least administrative effort, lowest cost, no downtime, most secure.
  3. Eliminate options that use the wrong scope or the wrong service.
  4. Choose the built-in Azure feature designed for the job.
  5. Answer every question; there is no penalty stated for a wrong answer.

Administrator habits: prefer managed identities to stored credentials, RBAC to sharing keys, private endpoints to public exposure, and policy to manual checks.

4A four-week study plan

Week Modules Goal
1 1 to 3 Identities, RBAC, governance
2 4 to 6 Storage
3 7 to 11 ARM and Bicep, virtual machines, containers, App Service
4 12 to 17 Networking, monitoring, backup, mixed practice

5Exam Q&A

5.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1What score is needed to pass the AZ-104 exam?

  • A600
  • B700
  • C750
  • D800
Show the answer

Answer: B. A score of 700 or greater out of 1,000 is required.

S2What was Azure Active Directory renamed to?

  • AAzure Directory Services
  • BMicrosoft Entra ID
  • CMicrosoft Identity Hub
  • DAzure Access Manager
Show the answer

Answer: B. Azure AD is now Microsoft Entra ID.

S3Which two domains together can account for up to half of the exam?

  • AStorage, and networking
  • BIdentities and governance, and compute
  • CMonitoring, and storage
  • DNetworking, and monitoring
Show the answer

Answer: B. Each of those two domains is 20 to 25 percent.

S4A question asks for the option with the least administrative effort. What should the candidate choose?

  • AA custom script that implements the same requirement step by step
  • BA manual process documented in a runbook for the operations team
  • CA built-in managed Azure feature that meets the requirement
  • DA third-party tool that must be installed and licensed separately
Show the answer

Answer: C. Managed features usually minimize administrative effort.

5.2 Recall questions

R1What is the passing score?

Show the answer

700 or greater out of 1,000.

R2How long is the exam?

Show the answer

100 minutes.

R3Name the five domains.

Show the answer

Identities and governance; storage; compute; virtual networking; monitoring and maintenance.

R4Which domain is the smallest?

Show the answer

Monitor and maintain Azure resources (10 to 15 percent).

R5What is the old name of Microsoft Entra ID?

Show the answer

Azure Active Directory.

R6After how long can a first retake be taken?

Show the answer

After 24 hours.

6Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Format 700 to pass, 100 minutes, proctored, interactive components possible
Domains 20-25 / 15-20 / 20-25 / 15-20 / 10-15 percent
Old name Azure AD = Microsoft Entra ID
Method read the last line, find the requirement, eliminate, choose the built-in feature
